newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: NAFTOTIEKIS MAY PROFIT 4.99 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: NAFTOTIEKIS MAY PROFIT 4.99 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuanian pipeline operator Birzu Naftotiekis said on Thursday that its profit before tax in May was 4.99 million litas compared to 4.8 million litas a month before.
It also said that its sales and services in May stood at 7.169 million litas versus 7.201 million litas in April.
"The company was operating at almost its full capacity in May, especially to Ventspils port," the finance director of the company, Ona Slaniene, told Reuters.
The company reported a first quarter net profit of 5.3 million litas and sales of 20.6 million litas.
Slaniene also said that the firm transported 1.954 million tonnes of crude oil and related products in May compared to 1.988 million tonnes a month before.
A total 1.24 million tonnes of crude and 234,000 tonnes of diesel fuel was transported to Ventspils port and 477,000 tonnes of crude went to Mazheikiu Nafta oil refinery in May.
In the first quarter, the company reported that it transported 5.2 million tonnes of crude and oil products.
The 90 percent state-run company transports oil and products from Russia to refinery Mazeikiu Nafta and Ventspils.
The government has said it was considering merging the firm into one national oil concern with Mazeikiu, Butinges and filling station group Lietuvos Kuras.
